days.title: Central Heritage and Wildlife
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Hoge Berg
stops.detail: The Hoge Berg near Oudeschild (15 meters) is a relic from the formation era and not a dune.

stops.name: De Zandkuil
stops.detail: The only insect protection area in the Netherlands, De Zandkuil (sand hollow), is located on the Hoge Berg.

stops.name: Den Burg
stops.detail: About 7000 inhabitants live in Den Burg, located slightly south of the center of the island, the only town with a truly urban character, which also houses the island administration, other governmental institutions, and many shops.

stops.name: Rommelpot
stops.detail: In the middle of the island there is a wetland, the Rommelpot.

days.driving: Allow time between these sights; local travel times are not verified and conditions vary.

days.title: Southern Peaks and Scenic Harbors
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: De Hors
stops.detail: At the southern tip, there is a sand and dune area several kilometers wide, De Hors.

stops.name: Oudeschild
stops.detail: Oudeschild, east of Den Burg, is characterized by fishing and a little industry, while De Cocksdorp at the northern tip of the island is a smaller coastal town.
